description: This is an HTML file serving as the main index page for a web-based database visualizer application. It contains the structure and client-side scripts for displaying database lists, tables, and data, along with UI elements for interaction.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list when user clicks the refresh button.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles display of tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays list of tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data into a HTML table with interactive cell expansion.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content.
